“老爹，李叔，你们回来了啊！”吴姜和王大雷赶忙上前，帮着两人拿东西。

李叔看到吴姜，还没坐下，就迫不及待的开口：“小姜，那幅明朝古画呢，快快给我欣赏一下！”

李叔对古字画，不是一般的喜欢，家里收藏了不少的好东西。

吴姜看着李叔急切的样子，有些好笑，从抽屉里拿出那幅苏婉清曾经附着的古画，递到李叔手里，李叔接过，立刻就在桌子上摊开了。

吴时安也凑上前观看，他也是个行家。

“好、好，我没看错，真的是张灵的真迹，这次是真的捡到大漏了！”李叔激动的说道。

“没错，你看这线条圆转遒劲、轻重有致，又兼能豪放写意、神情生动，算是张灵的一幅佳作了！”吴时安也在一旁附和。

两人足足欣赏了半个小时，这才直起身子，来到茶台旁边坐下。

吴时安喝了一口茶，这才开口问道：“说说吧，小姜，到底怎么回事？”

“是这样的......”

吴姜一五一十的将画的问题说了，苏婉清的事情，只是一语带过。只是说了，成为这幅画的主人，将会面临的危害。

吴姜又将邪道的事情给李叔说了，让他自己考虑，要不要收藏这幅画，他也不确定，后续有没有风险。

李叔倒不是很在意，反而对着吴姜夸赞道：“没想到你小子还有这本事！你爸跟我说的时候，我还半信半疑，没想到肚子里真的有货！这下好了，以后你叔我要是再碰到这种古怪麻烦，也就不用到处找人了，直接找你小子就行！”

吴姜听着李叔的话，心里暗自嘀咕，李叔这语气，是以前应该也碰到过类似的邪门事吗？

正想着，李叔又拍了拍他的肩膀，笑着说道：“对了小姜，明天就是周六了，芽芽今天晚上就从学校回来了，明天别忘了来家里玩啊。”

吴姜含糊的应了一声，也没说答应，还是不答应，转身和王大雷一起去车上拿货去了。

老吴出差几天辛苦了，王雅琴晚上做了一桌子好菜，父子俩大快朵颐的吃了一顿。

期间，老吴同志和小吴同志比赛似的，将王雅琴的手艺夸上了天，将王雅琴哄得亲自给老吴同志倒了二两酒，一家之主的位置，一目了然。

吴姜吃完就溜回房间去了，留下夫妻俩在那里腻歪。

照例等到深夜，吴姜这才偷偷溜出了家门，开车去了城郊一处偏僻的公园。

从后备箱拎出香火纸钱，按照朱宏之前教他的方法，将东西分成了五份，除了黑白无常两位顶头上司，还有牛头马面两位阴帅的。当然，也没忘了朱宏这位好大哥。

等一切办完，半个小时已经过去了，吴姜等没有火星了，这才开车往家驶去。

悄悄的进屋，等躺到了床上，吴姜才松了口气。正准备闭眼睡觉，心神悸动了一下。

"Dad, Uncle Li, you are back!" Wu Jiang and Wang Dalei hurried forward to help them get their things.

When Uncle Li saw Wu Jiang, he couldn't wait to speak before he sat down: "Xiao Jiang, where's that ancient Ming Dynasty painting? Come and appreciate it for me!"

Uncle Li is not a general fan of ancient calligraphy and painting, and has a lot of good things collected at home.

Seeing Uncle Li's eagerness, Wu Jiang was a little amused. He took out the ancient painting that Su Wanqing had attached to him from the drawer and handed it to Uncle Li. Uncle Li took it and immediately spread it out on the table.

Wu Shi'an also came forward to watch. He was also an expert.

"Okay, okay, I read it right. It's really Zhang Ling's authentic work. I really found a big leak this time!" Uncle Li said excitedly.

"That's right, you see, the lines are round and strong, the weights are consistent, and they are also bold and freehand, with vivid expressions. It can be regarded as a masterpiece of Zhang Ling!" Wu Shi'an also agreed.

The two of them admired it for half an hour, then straightened up and sat down next to the tea table.

Wu Shi'an took a sip of tea and then asked: "Tell me, Xiao Jiang, what's going on?"

"That's it..."

Wu Jiang talked about the painting issue in detail, but only mentioned Su Wanqing's matter in one sentence.I'm just talking about the dangers you will face if you become the owner of this painting.

Wu Jiang told Uncle Li about the evil ways again and asked him to consider whether to collect this painting. He was not sure whether there would be any subsequent risks.

Uncle Li didn't care very much, but praised Wu Jiang: "I didn't expect your boy to have such ability! When your father told me, I was still half-believed, but I didn't expect that he really had something in his stomach! Now, if your uncle and I encounter this kind of weird trouble again, we don't have to look for people everywhere, we can just go to your boy!"

Wu Jiang listened to Uncle Li's words and murmured to himself. Uncle Li's tone suggested that he had encountered similar evil things before?

Just as he was thinking about it, Uncle Li patted him on the shoulder again and said with a smile: "By the way, Xiao Jiang, tomorrow is Saturday. Yaya is back from school tonight. Don't forget to come and play at home tomorrow."

Wu Jiang responded vaguely, without saying yes. He still refused and turned around to go to the car with Wang Dalei to get the goods.

Lao Wu had been on a business trip for a few days and had a hard time. Wang Yaqin cooked a table of delicious dishes in the evening, and the father and son devoured the meal.

During this period, Comrade Lao Wu and Comrade Xiao Wu seemed to be competing, praising Wang Yaqin's craftsmanship to the heavens, and coaxing Wang Yaqin into pouring two ounces of wine for Comrade Lao Wu herself. The position of the head of the family was clear at a glance.

After Wu Jiang finished eating, he slipped back to the room, leaving the couple there.

As usual, Wu Jiang waited until late at night before sneaking out of the house and driving to a remote park on the outskirts of the city.

He took out the incense and paper money from the trunk and divided the things into five parts according to the method Zhu Hong had taught him before. In addition to the two immediate bosses, Black and White Wuchang, there were also two handsome men with bull heads and horse faces.Of course, I have not forgotten the good big brother Zhu Hong.

By the time everything was done, half an hour had passed. Wu Jiang waited until there were no more sparks, then drove home.

Wu Jiang quietly entered the room and lay on the bed, then he breathed a sigh of relief.Just as he was about to close his eyes and sleep, his heart palpitated.
